recentItems.title: LAST MAN IN TOWER - Official Trailer | Manoj Bajpayee, Divya Dutta, Boman Irani | Ben Rekhi| 11 Sept
recentItems.description:
What is a home worth - a lifetime of memories or the highest bid someone is willing to pay?
How far will MasterJi go to stand by his truth? Watch and find out -  Last Man in Tower releasing 11th September

Based on Aravind Adiga’s bestselling novel, Last Man in Tower is a sharp and unsettling story about ambition, morality, friendship and the dangerous lengths ordinary people can go to when their dreams have a price.
